card.purpose: Represent one scannable object, summary, or decision surface with tokenized surface behavior, state, accessibility, and responsive layout responsibility.
card.referenceRationale: Use ZIP base variants default, minimal, elevated, and ghost. Use composition for stats, compact, and media card anatomy; keep KPI Tile for dashboard metric ownership beyond Card.

anatomy.rule: Owns border, radius, shadow, padding, and surface role.
Optional Material Symbol supports recognition without replacing text.
Short object or decision label remains available to assistive tech.
Optional prominent datum or status wraps safely.
Explains scan value, state, or next action.
Hover, focus, selected, loading, error, disabled, and muted resolve before styling.

variants.use: Transparent surface for dense supporting content.
Raised surface when hierarchy needs more depth.
Subtle translucent surface over contextual backgrounds.

card.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > selected > focus > hover > muted > interactive > default

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title and accessible name source.

props.name: value
props.description: Prominent value, status, or object summary.

props.name: unit
props.description: Optional unit prefix for stats composition values.

props.name: detail
props.description: Supporting text that explains scan value or recovery.

props.name: status
props.description: Short visible status label.

props.name: trend
props.description: Trend tone for stats composition status.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional approved symbol for recognition.

props.name: media
props.description: Optional media URL for media composition.

props.name: mediaAlt
props.description: Accessible alt text for media composition when the image carries meaning.

props.name: variant
props.description: Surface treatment governed by Flow tokens.

props.name: composition
props.description: Internal Card composition informed by ZIP reference without changing surface variant semantics.

props.name: state
props.type: default | hover | focus | selected | loading | error | disabled | muted | interactive
props.description: Resolved UI state before styling.

props.name: density
props.description: Density context from Flow.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Allows the Card to fill its owning layout.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Makes the whole surface keyboard/actionable when no nested actions exist.

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks the surface as selected and syncs aria-pressed when interactive.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Removes whole-surface activation and applies disabled state.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows loading state and aria-busy.

props.name: actions
props.description: Nested Flow Button or IconButton actions; disables whole-card button behavior.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Whole-surface action handler when Card is interactive.

productExamples.example: Card presents balance, activity state, and next action without owning process sequencing.
Selected Card shows chosen station, distance, availability, and route readiness.
Dashboard Card scans one metric and recovery count.

do: Use Card for one scannable object or decision surface.
Keep title, value, description, and state legible.
Let parent layout define grid and width.
dont: Do not nest decorative cards inside cards.
Do not move product flows into the base component.
Do not use raw shadows, radii, color, or spacing.
info: Card-led processs such as KPI Card or Mobile Card Overview remain patterns.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: single-column stack with one scan value and next action
two-column comparison when content remains readable
scan grids with larger targets and explicit state labels

tests: Renders semantic surface with title, description, optional icon, and state.
Interactive Card is keyboard reachable and preserves focus visibility.
Default, hover, focus, selected, loading, error, disabled, and muted states remain distinct.
Mobile stack, desktop grid, and dense dashboard layouts do not overflow.
Surface, border, radius, padding, elevation, motion, icon, and text resolve through Design System tokens.
agentInstructions: Use Card for a single object, summary, or decision surface.
Move product sequencing and processs to patterns.
Preserve surface semantics, state, responsive behavior, and accessibility before adding visual richness.
rejectIf: Card is used as a decorative wrapper.
Product sequencing is hidden inside the base component.
State is color-only or recovery text is missing.
inventoryEscalations: CardStats maps to Card composition stats because the ZIP renders Card + mono value + Badge; KPI Tile owns dashboard thresholds, sparkline, and drill-in.
CardInteractive maps to Card interactive behavior, not a variant.
CardCompact maps to Card composition compact.
CardMedia maps to Card composition media.
CardElevated, CardMinimal, and CardGhost map to base Card variants.
